stemMd: A stock lasts 18 days at normal daily use. After 6 days, daily use rises by 50%. How many further days will the remaining stock last?
explanationMd: After six days, 12 normal-day units remain. At 1.5 normal-day units per day, they last 12/1.5=8 further days. Increasing consumption shortens the remaining duration.

distractorRationale.a: This halves the remaining duration instead of dividing by 1.5.
distractorRationale.e: This increases duration when consumption rises.
distractorRationale.c: This applies the change to the original 18 days without accounting for use.
